name: Triveni Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1968, Triveni Enterprises
 Ltd trades in various products, and is also
a distributor of telecommunication products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TEL, an ISO 9001:2008 certified company, was initially engaged in trading iron and steel products such as angles, beams, channels, plates, and sheets used in construction, automotive, and engineering sectors. It also offered slitting, cutting, de-coiling, and straightening services at its 17-acre warehousing facility in Bangalore. Currently, TEL has diversified into trading textiles and other products, and also distributes telecommunication equipment.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.71 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.11% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 282 days.
